metadata.description: Reference sustainability benchmarks for Italian sectors
metadata.note: Values are indicative averages for benchmarking purposes. Actual figures vary significantly by company size, geography, and sub-sector. Verify against current sector-specific data before using in formal reports.

units.renewable_energy_pct: % of total energy from renewable sources
units.water_intensity_m3_per_employee: cubic meters per employee per year
units.waste_recycling_rate_pct: % of total waste recycled or recovered
units.ltir: Lost Time Injury Rate per 1,000,000 hours worked
units.scope3_pct_of_total: typical % that Scope 3 represents of total GHG emissions

manufacturing_ceramics.label: Ceramics Manufacturing
manufacturing_ceramics.description: Ceramic tiles, sanitaryware, and technical ceramics. Major Italian cluster in Emilia-Romagna (Sassuolo district).
manufacturing_ceramics.notes: High energy intensity due to kiln operations (natural gas). The Italian ceramics sector is a leader in waste recycling (re-use of fired scrap and raw material recovery). Scope 3 is driven by raw material extraction and logistics.

manufacturing_general.label: General Manufacturing
manufacturing_general.description: Broad manufacturing sector including machinery, metalworking, and industrial equipment. Italy's core industrial base.
manufacturing_general.notes: Highly diversified sector. Italian SMEs (PMI) may show higher intensity per employee due to smaller scale. Scope 3 dominated by purchased materials and components.

food_processing.label: Food & Beverage Processing
food_processing.description: Food processing, beverage production, and agricultural product transformation. Includes pasta, dairy, wine, olive oil, and meat processing.
food_processing.notes: Very high water intensity, especially in dairy and beverage sub-sectors. Scope 3 is dominant due to agricultural supply chain emissions (livestock, fertilisers, land use). High LTIR reflects manual handling and cold environments.

energy_utilities.label: Energy & Utilities
energy_utilities.description: Electric power generation, gas distribution, and multi-utilities. Italy's energy transition sector.
energy_utilities.notes: Highest Scope 1+2 intensity due to fossil-fuel generation. Italy's renewable share (~42% of electricity) is growing rapidly (solar, hydro, wind). Water intensity is high due to cooling in thermal plants. Training hours are higher due to safety requirements.

fashion_textiles.label: Fashion & Textiles
fashion_textiles.description: Textile manufacturing, fashion design, leather goods, and luxury brands. Major Italian districts in Tuscany, Veneto, and Lombardy.
fashion_textiles.notes: High water intensity in dyeing and finishing processes. Scope 3 is very high due to raw material production (cotton, wool, synthetic fibres), global supply chains, and end-of-life. Women represent a majority of the workforce. Waste recycling is improving with circular fashion initiatives.

construction.label: Construction & Building
construction.description: Residential and commercial construction, infrastructure, and building materials. Boosted by Superbonus renovation incentives.
construction.notes: Highest LTIR of all sectors due to physical hazard exposure. Low women representation. Italy has a strong construction waste recycling rate thanks to regulations. Scope 3 dominated by embodied carbon in building materials (cement, steel). Training hours include mandatory safety courses.

chemicals.label: Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals
chemicals.description: Chemical production, pharmaceuticals, and specialty chemicals. Major sites in Lombardy, Piedmont, and Porto Marghera.
chemicals.notes: Very high water intensity for process cooling and cleaning. Pharmaceuticals sub-sector has higher women representation and training. LTIR is relatively low thanks to mature safety culture and Responsible Care programmes. High Scope 1 from process emissions.

automotive.label: Automotive & Components
automotive.description: Vehicle assembly, automotive components, and parts manufacturing. Centred around Turin (Stellantis) and northern Italian supply chain.
automotive.notes: Highest Scope 3 share due to use-phase emissions of vehicles and purchased materials (steel, aluminium, plastics). Very high waste recycling driven by EU ELV directive. Electrification is reshaping the sector. Low women representation, though improving in R&D roles.
